title: A fix verifier at the reviewed head stands in for round 2
why: parse_review demands rounds 1, 2, 3 in a row. A lane whose path is round 1 FAIL, fix verifier, round 3 must run a filler round 2 to post a record. That hit #3060 and #3116 on Nov 12-13. The cost is a wasted review round each time, and a record whose order does not match what happened.
note: Guard change, to a lane, red first. Before building, the lane reads rule roles-review-cap-three (rounds 1 and 2 fix the defect; a small fix gets a fix verifier) and decision pr-review-record, and names the sentence that lets a fix verifier count as round 2. If no sentence allows it, the lane asks first (outcomes-stale-decision-protocol). Step review-record-no-restart asked for this path at 03:01 CST, but #3116 did not cover it. 03:59 CST Nov 13, triage read the two sources the #3116 lane named (coordinator 03:58 CST). Neither forbids the step. Item 402 a (owner, 2026-11-08 06:08 CST; decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 lines 19-26) only requires round 3 with the net-value test on a guard or check change, even after a passing fix check; it does not require a real round 2. Item 347 a (owner, 13:12 CST Nov 7; step review-fix-check-round, doing) makes a failed fix check the next round, so a fix check already takes a round's place in the count. No decision on main is named review-fix-check-round; its home is that step. The form gap stands: pr-review-record's path 'fix verifier, then round 3' cannot be posted without a real round 2. The lane still names the sentence before it builds; if 347 a's text reads only on FAIL, it asks first.
